verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Gitea tracks requirements, features and bugs as issues, and that issues support labels, assignments, milestones, due dates and dependencies. That covers every element of the story. The evidence is short marketing-level summaries rather than in-depth feature docs, and no community or hands-on report confirms the labels/assignees workflow. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of labels and assignee management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bugs, features, and requirements as issues with labels and assignees

citations.quote: Efficiently manage requirements, features, and bugs through issue tasks, labels, and kanban boards.
Gitea tracks project requirements, features, and bugs through columns and issues.
Issues support features like branches, tags, milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates, dependencies, and more.
